title: 情報通信ネットワーク
subtitle: Network Technology of Information processing and Communication
educationalGoal: Information and Communication Technology (ICT) including IoT and related technologies is an indispensable factor in the social infrastructure. Especially, in communication networks, understanding communication protocol and network configurations are important items. This course focuses on these items. Moreover, this course comes in touch with the latest trends and future directions in ICT.
advice:
This course is a systems approach of fundamental technologies including "Communication and Network system" and "Transmission of Electronic Information".

This course includes the following topics.
(1) Overview of communication network focusing on the Internet
(2) Communication protocols in each layer of the Internet reference model
  - Data link layer (Ethernet, Wireless LAN)
  - Network layer (IPv4, IPv6)
  - Transport layer (TCP, UDP)
(3) Applications on the Internet
  - e-mail
  - Web access
  - File transfer, etc.
(4) Basic technologies on performance analysis in networks
(5) IoT services and technologies
(6) The latest topics in ICT by a guest lecturer

achievementLevels.ideal:
Students can explain following items with precision.
(1) Key technical terms in the ICT field
(2) Communication mechanisms of current networks and future directions
(3) Modeling and performance evaluation techniques for networks
achievementLevels.standard:
Students can explain roughly following items with hesitations
(1) Key technical terms in the ICT field
(2) Mechanisms of Ethernet, Wireless LAN and TCP/IP
(3) Future directions of communication networks

              Information and Communication Technology (ICT) including IoT and related technologies is an indispensable factor in the social infrastructure. Especially, in communication networks, understanding communication protocol and network configurations are important items. This course focuses on these items. Moreover, this course comes in touch with the latest trends and future directions in ICT.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course is a systems approach of fundamental technologies including "Communication and Network system" and "Transmission of Electronic Information".

This course includes the following topics.
(1) Overview of communication network focusing on the Internet
(2) Communication protocols in each layer of the Internet reference model
  - Data link layer (Ethernet, Wireless LAN)
  - Network layer (IPv4, IPv6)
  - Transport layer (TCP, UDP)
(3) Applications on the Internet
  - e-mail
  - Web access
  - File transfer, etc.
(4) Basic technologies on performance analysis in networks
(5) IoT services and technologies
(6) The latest topics in ICT by a guest lecturer
